notes.title: Brasília Game Festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611678/9a4d1f619683b07fe5080da362fce860347d7add.png[/img]

"Queen of the Community" was selected to be a part of [url=https://brasiliagamefestival.com.br/]Brasília Game Festival[/url] on May 16-18th!

Come and join us there and be one of the first people to play the game!
